subject: Limited disclosure addendum & request for time-bound watermarked access to vulnerability evidence
body:
From: Daniela Ruiz <daniela@astercloud.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: vulnerability report + exec summary for SIG/SOC2 evidence (NDA/redaction)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the quick sync yesterday. Our SOC2 auditor and SIG assessor have asked for the recent independent vulnerability assessment and an executive summary for our upcoming evidence drop. We understand these contain sensitive details; we are happy to sign a narrow-scope disclosure addendum.

Can Redwood provide:
- a redacted executive summary we can put in the auditor packet, and
- controlled access to the full findings (if possible) under NDA for our security team and auditor?

The auditor will be listed as: Security Partners LLP (contact: security@astercloud.com). Primary internal reviewers are myself (daniela@astercloud.com) and our lead infra engineer (shaun@astercloud.com). Please let us know the minimum process you need (NDA + redaction matrix? secure viewer?).

Regards,
Daniela Ruiz
Head of Compliance | AsterCloud Solutions

---

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Daniela Ruiz <daniela@astercloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: vulnerability report + exec summary for SIG/SOC2 evidence (NDA/redaction)

Hi Daniela —

Thank you — we can absolutely support a controlled disclosure for audit purposes. To keep this quick and low-friction, our proposed approach is:

1) Sign a limited-scope disclosure addendum (I attached a one-page addendum template). The addendum restricts reuse, prohibits external redistribution, and limits the retention window.
2) Redwood provides a time-limited, watermarked secure viewer link (per-user) for the full technical report. Viewer access can be configured for 7 or 14 days; we recommend 7 for audit evidence.
3) We provide a redacted executive summary PDF up front for the auditor packet.
4) We will share a redaction matrix (template attached) showing the categories we typically redact (attacker IPs, internal hostnames, customer-identifying strings). You can request specific carve-outs in writing.

Action items from us: Kimberly will own the redaction decisions and produce the redacted exec summary. Jonas will prepare a remediation status table for any open findings.

Can you confirm the exact list of reviewer emails (auditor + internal reviewers) and whether a 7-day viewer window is acceptable? Once we have the signed addendum, we’ll provision access and send the exec summary.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

-- Attachment: redaction_matrix_template.xlsx (stub) --

From: Daniela Ruiz <daniela@astercloud.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@astercloud.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: vulnerability report + exec summary for SIG/SOC2 evidence (NDA/redaction)

Sofia —

Thanks, that flow works for us. I attached the signed limited-scope addendum (signed by our CISO) and the list of reviewers:
- daniela@astercloud.com (Head of Compliance)
- shaun.martin@astercloud.com (Infra Lead)
- security@astercloud.com (Security Partners LLP - auditor inbox)

A couple asks from our side:
- Per-user watermarks and an export restriction (no download) on the secure viewer.
- Time-boxed access (7 days preferred).
- If you can provide a short redaction summary (what you removed), that would help our auditor acceptance.

We’re hoping to include the exec summary in our SIG submission by Oct 5; a 7-day viewer window will work as long as the exec summary is delivered quickly.

I’ve uploaded the signed addendum to the DocuSign link you shared in the portal.

Thanks,
Daniela

-- Attachment: signed_limited_disclosure_addendum.pdf (stub) --

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Daniela Ruiz <daniela@astercloud.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: vulnerability report + exec summary for SIG/SOC2 evidence (NDA/redaction)

Hi Daniela —

Appreciate the swift turnaround and the signed addendum. A couple of clarifying points so we can produce the right artifacts:

- Purpose: Is the exec summary only for auditor review (read-only into evidence package) or will it be circulated to internal stakeholders beyond the three reviewer emails?
- Redaction boundary: Our default redaction removes: attacker IPs, internal hostnames/FQDNs, screenshots with customer IDs, and low-level stack traces that reference internal identifiers. We keep the vulnerability descriptions, severity, and remediation guidance intact.
- Deliverables: We will provide: (A) redacted Executive Summary PDF, (B) secure-viewer access to full report with per-user watermarking and download disabled, (C) redaction summary (one-page) describing categories removed.

We can do a 7-day viewer window with watermarks and disable downloads; for auditors that require a copy we can discuss a limited, encrypted artifact exchange under an escrow addendum.

Please confirm that the three reviewer emails are final and whether Shaun should have download rights for triage. If not, we’ll proceed with read-only.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Trust & Security Operations | Redwood Inference

-- Attachment: redaction_matrix_filled_partial.xlsx (stub) --

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Daniela Ruiz <daniela@astercloud.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: vulnerability report + exec summary for SIG/SOC2 evidence (NDA/redaction) — remediation status

Hi Daniela —

I’m sharing a short remediation status overview for the findings that are likely referenced in the report. This will help you and the auditor decide whether to accept the exec summary for the October 5 submission.

Summary of notable items referenced in the report:
- CVE-2027-12345 (high) — vulnerable dependency in auth service. Fixed: patch deployed to production 2027-09-20; verification completed 2027-09-22.
- CVE-2027-23456 (medium) — default admin creds exposure in staging. Mitigated: credential rotation + policy enforcement 2027-09-18; staging cleaned.
- CVE-2027-34567 (high) — insecure S3 bucket ACL discovered. Remediation planned: configuration rollout and monitoring rule; ETA 2027-10-15.
- Several informational items (low) addressed via configuration hardening (completed).

I’ll attach a remediation tracker CSV with per-item status, owners, and verification notes. If you prefer a more formal signoff, we can provide a short attestation from our engineering team once the final fixes are verified.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

-- Attachment: remediation_tracker.csv (stub) --

From: Daniela Ruiz <daniela@astercloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: vulnerability report + exec summary for SIG/SOC2 evidence (NDA/redaction)

Thanks Jonas — that level of detail is perfect. The auditor will accept the redacted exec summary for the submission if the remediation statuses are transparent (we’ll include the tracker).

Two quick asks:
- Please deliver the redacted exec summary PDF via secure viewer today if possible.
- Provide the one-page redaction summary describing what was removed (categories only).

We will not request downloads; watermarked, read-only access is fine. DocuSign addendum already signed.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Daniela

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniela Ruiz <daniela@astercloud.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: vulnerability report + exec summary for SIG/SOC2 evidence (NDA/redaction) — provisioning

Kimberly / Jonas —

Per Daniela’s confirmation: please provision a 7-day watermarked secure viewer for the three reviewer emails and upload: (1) redacted Executive_Summary_v2-redacted.pdf, (2) one-page redaction_summary.pdf, (3) remediation_tracker.csv.

Kimberly — please add a short note in the redaction summary clarifying the default redaction categories (attacker IPs, internal hostnames, internal customer identifiers, full stack traces). Jonas — finalize the tracker rows for CVE-2027-34567 with owner and ETA.

Daniela — we will send the secure viewer link to you shortly (watermarked, read-only, no download). If the auditor needs an encrypted copy, we’ll coordinate an escrow process.

Thanks everyone — closing this out on our side once provisioning is complete.

Sofia Ivanova
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
